Strategy: Triangular peak at twice the item size: score falls with the absolute distance between a bin's residual and 2*item, so the preferred bin is the one that leaves exactly one item-sized gap after placement, keeping a same-size slot open. It can fail when item sizes vary widely, since the reserved gap rarely matches the next item and tight packing would have saved bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - 2 * item) for r in bins]
```
